PMModelProps.Name: Quill Business
PMModelProps.PMDescriptionString: This model describes the existing Quill Computers core processes and major activities so that the reengineering team can analyze and redesign them. The team has decided to use IDEF0 in a practical way to document the business processes. To avoid cluttering, activity mechanisms will be shown in a separate matrix. Only critical controls will be shown in the model.
PMModelProps.PMScope: To improve the core business processes in terms of cost, quality and cycle time.
PMModelProps.PMSource: Reengineering team comprising of the following individuals: Customer Service manager Production manager Production scheduler Assembly supervisor Purchasing manager Warehousing supervisor Technical Support manager Inspection/QC supervisor Product Configuration manager

PMTextBlockProps.PMTextString: NOTE: Camera-ready ads are produced/proofed internally and are sent electronically to publications. Advertising Policy: For any item whose price is expected to change while the ad is running the price should be replaced with "CALL FOR PRICE". Pricing Policy: Determined by activity-based costing. Credit Policy: Credit card. Approval by card issuing bank. Checks accepted, order not to be shipped until check clears.

PMDiagramProps.PMTextString: A4 -- Testing Feedback OR (Approved Designs AND CTDS)

PMTextBlockProps.PMTextString:
NOTE: The TO-BE is based on selecting and approving vendors first (on the basis of financial and performance criteria) and then to narrow the selection (on the basis of matching their parts and components gamut with specification requirements.
CTDS: Configuration, Testing and Debugging System Instructions
NOTE: "Check availability of returned parts" has been eliminated by repairing customer returns in an assembly area and maintaining a separate inventory of fixed returned "ready-to-go" units.

NOTE 1:
RTCR - Request to troubleshoot customer returns has become part of the receiving and assembly process. Customer support issues "returned orders instructions" to Production which instructs Assembly and Shipping accordingly as to the course of action required.
NOTE The output "General information" is tunneled because it represents marginal activity volume The output "Phonecalls to customers" is tunneled to avoid cluttering the upper-layer diagrams
